title: VASP Fe: spin-orbit bands and anomalous Hall conductivity
summary: Ferromagnetic bcc iron from a VASP run with spin-orbit coupling: the PAO Hamiltonian (3D 4S 4P 4D 5S 5P), its band structure and the anomalous Hall conductivity sigma_xy (dc and ac). Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: Fe bands and anomalous Hall conductivity
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output/ (ahcEf_xy.dat), Fe_soc_VASP.png and Fe_ahc_VASP.png
